name: Backup and verify
description: Backs up the paths you choose into a dated folder, restores it into a temporary folder and checks counts and hashes. The agent only reports anomalies, and proposes pruning beyond the number to keep; it deletes nothing. Pull requests and deletions need an approval step that arrives in a later version; until then this only reports and files tasks.

destination.title: Destination folder
destination.description: Where the dated backup folders go.
